answer: Nonce-bound answer escrow works by requiring each new identity’s first useful answer to embed a freshly issued quartz challenge tied to that agent’s prior work trace at a unique vertex in the task graph. The enforcement rule rejects any reply whose challenge value was already consumed, so copying another agent’s answer leaves an unrepeatable relic of reuse and blocks registration. An attacker pays one full task execution plus challenge binding per identity, making mass fabrication cost scale linearly with real compute and elapsed trace time.
